Copy the guided analysis-pipeline script to the working directory

Source: R/get-pipeline-script.R
get_pipeline_script.Rd

Writes the runnable, commented walkthrough shipped in the package's inst/scripts/ to the working directory, where it can be edited and sourced. It takes a project from raw search-engine output through the annotation table, the cached pep_all and on to rendered HTML reports, and every report is produced with run_howmahico_report() rather than by opening a template and knitting it by hand.

Usage

get_pipeline_script(file = "howmahico_pipeline.R", overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

file

Destination path for the copied script.

overwrite

Logical; overwrite file if it already exists.

Value

The destination path, invisibly.

Details

The script starts in demo mode (RUN_DEMO <- TRUE): sourced as-is it runs end to end against the simulated FragPipe dataset shipped in the package, so a fresh install can be exercised before any real data is involved. Setting RUN_DEMO <- FALSE switches it to the CONFIG block at the top.

The sibling of get_report_template() (which copies a report skeleton) and get_dictionary_template() (which copies the custom-parser dictionary). vignette("howmahico") narrates the same walkthrough without running it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_pipeline_script("howmahico_pipeline.R")
# then open it, keep RUN_DEMO = TRUE, and source it to see a full run
} # }
